q1_what_did_you_play: I played Dodoco Blast, then Kaboom! on Twig Slime (S), killing it, then Duck and Cover.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Bang Bang! instead of Dodoco Blast, followed by Kaboom! and Duck and Cover, but its random 10 damage was less reliable than dealing 7 to every enemy.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the chance for Bang Bang!'s two random hits to concentrate 10 damage on one enemy; instead, it guaranteed broader damage and removed the 4-damage attacker.
q4_different_intent: Yes. A sufficiently dangerous attack telegraphed by one of the Leaf Slimes could have made me consider the concentrated but random Bang Bang! line or change the Kaboom! target.
